title: Pure Goyo
summary: Pure Goyo and Sector Security Synchro beatdown build, channeling Officer Trudge's pursuit tactics and monster-stealing authority. The deck swarms EARTH Warriors to summon Goyo Defender, which triplicates itself from the Extra Deck to power rapid climbs into Goyo Guardian, Goyo King, and the devastating Fusion boss Goyo Emperor.

summary.title: Starters & Swarming
points: Junk Forward and Spell Striker Special Summon themselves from hand without using a Normal Summon, providing free Level 3 EARTH Warrior bodies.
Psychic Wheeleder Special Summons itself from hand while you control a Level 3 monster, acting as a Level 3 EARTH Tuner that pops a monster with less ATK upon Synchro Summon.
Attack Gainer (Level 1 EARTH Tuner) pairs with Level 2 monsters or Super Quantum Red Layer to make Goyo Synchros without consuming resources.
Reinforcement of the Army searches any of your key Warrior starters or Tuners: Jutte Fighter, Attack Gainer, Junk Forward, or Spell Striker.

summary.title: Opening: Goyo Defender Triplication
steps: Special Summon Junk Forward from your hand while you control no monsters.
Normal Summon Jutte Fighter (or tune Level 1 Attack Gainer with a Level 2 monster) to Synchro Summon Level 3 Goyo Defender.
Activate Goyo Defender's effect: while you control only EARTH Warrior Synchro Monsters, Special Summon a second Goyo Defender from your Extra Deck.
Activate the second Goyo Defender's effect to Special Summon a third copy from the Extra Deck, turning 1 Synchro Summon into 3 monsters.
Overlay two Goyo Defenders into The Phantom Knights of Break Sword, or tune with an EARTH Tuner for Goyo King, or banish them with Miracle Synchro Fusion for Goyo Emperor.

summary.title: Bosses & Monster Theft
points: Goyo Guardian (Level 6 Synchro, 2800 ATK) Special Summons any opponent's monster it destroys by battle directly to your field in Defense Position.
Goyo King (Level 8 Synchro) gains 400 ATK per EARTH Warrior Synchro on the field, steals monsters it destroys by battle, and when it destroys a monster can take control of another face-up monster.

Goyo Emperor (Level 10 Fusion, summoned via Miracle Synchro Fusion) steals any monster that you or your stolen monsters destroy by battle, and tributes an EARTH Warrior Synchro to take control of an opponent's Special Summoned monster.
Goyo Chaser and Goyo Predator provide mid-level battle theft with ATK buffs and damage halving.

summary.title: Spells & Extra Deck Options
points: Miracle Synchro Fusion banishes 2 EARTH Warrior Synchro Monsters from your field or GY (such as used Goyo Defenders) to Fusion Summon Goyo Emperor, and draws 1 card if destroyed while Set.
Jutte Fighter switches an opponent's monster to Defense Position, making high-ATK monsters easy prey for Goyo attackers.
Naturia Beast is summoned using Level 2 EARTH Tuner Jutte Fighter and Level 3 Junk Forward, milling 2 cards to negate and destroy Spell Cards indefinitely.
The Phantom Knights of Break Sword uses two Level 3 Goyo Defenders to pop an opponent's card alongside one of yours.

allow.Jutte Fighter: Trudge's signature Level 2 EARTH Warrior Tuner that switches an opponent's Attack Position monster to Defense Position (making it easy to destroy by battle with Goyo monsters to steal it!) and satisfies the EARTH Tuner requirement of Goyo Guardian and Goyo Chaser.
allow.Junk Forward: Level 3 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; Normal Summoning a Level 3 EARTH Tuner (Psychic Wheeleder) alongside it makes Level 6 Goyo Guardian, or pairing a Level 1 EARTH Tuner with a Level 2 makes Level 3 Goyo Defender!
allow.Super Quantum Red Layer: Level 5 Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters; pairs with Level 1 EARTH Tuner Attack Gainer to immediately Synchro Summon Level 6 Goyo Guardian without using your Normal Summon!
allow.Attack Gainer: Level 1 EARTH Warrior Tuner that pairs with Level 2 monsters to Synchro Summon Level 3 Goyo Defender (which then summons 2 more Goyo Defenders from the Extra Deck!).
allow.Spell Striker: Level 3 EARTH Warrior that banishes a Spell from the GY to Special Summon itself; pairs with Level 3 EARTH Tuner Psychic Wheeleder for Goyo Guardian, or with Level 2 Jutte Fighter for Level 5 Goyo Chaser.
allow.Psychic Wheeleder: Level 3 EARTH Psychic Tuner that Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 3 monster (Junk Forward, Spell Striker, or Goyo Defender!) and pops a monster when used for a Synchro Summon.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Jutte Fighter, Attack Gainer, Junk Forward, or Spell Striker.
allow.Naturia Beast: Level 5 EARTH Beast Synchro made with Level 2 EARTH Tuner Jutte Fighter + Level 3 Junk Forward that sends the top 2 cards of your Deck to the GY to negate Spell card activations.
allow.The Phantom Knights of Break Sword: Rank 3 Xyz made with two Level 3 Goyo Defenders that detaches 1 material to destroy 1 card you control and 1 card the opponent controls.
